name: nipopow-cutover
description: A NiPoPoW proof-form change deployed on a running network: serving peers build their stored proof on the base jar and are then upgraded in place (UPGRADE), and a bootstrapping joiner on the new or the old jar (JOINER) asks them for a proof. The base role runs the same restarts on the base jar (the control). The candidate passes a run when the joiner applies a proof and receives no wrong one (`pass`, the hook's own PASS); it also reports whether the joiner applies or rejects a proof, whom it asked, and what the upgraded servers had to serve and when.
